statutory_jurisdictions: China NMPA Decree No. 739 (Regulations on Supervision and Administration of Medical Devices)
U.S. FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR (Quality Management System Regulation)

axioms.title: ISO 13485 Lead Auditor Prerequisite
axioms.plain_english: An ISO 13485 Lead Auditor must hold a recognized certification issued by an accredited registrar (e.g., CNCA, IRCA) with at least 3 years of verifiable tenure.

axioms.title: Class III Cleanroom Sterilization Lead
axioms.plain_english: A Class III medical device sterilization validation lead must possess validated competency in Ethylene Oxide (EO) or Radiation sterilization and documented cleanroom operations in ISO Class 5 or Class 7 environments.

axioms.title: Full-Time QA On-Site Exclusivity
axioms.plain_english: A full-time on-site Quality Assurance Director cannot concurrently hold another full-time on-site role at a geographically disjoint facility.
